# IEC 60601-1 — Medical electrical equipment — Part 1: General requirements for basic safety and essential performance

**Standard**: IEC 60601-1 [VERIFY — confirm edition and year applicable to 510(k) submission]
**Category**: Medical electrical equipment — basic safety and essential performance
**Referenced In**: [VERIFY — populate from source] (FDA recognized consensus standards database; 510(k) submission)
**Module Applicability**: Custom medical electrical hardware of the infusion pump — power supply, motor drive, fluid delivery assembly, user-facing electrical interfaces, and any associated accessories

## Overview

IEC 60601-1 establishes general requirements for basic safety and essential performance of medical electrical (ME) equipment and ME systems. It applies to this project because the infusion device includes custom medical electrical hardware — notably the mains/battery power subsystem, motor drive for the pump mechanism, fluid delivery assembly, and user-facing electrical interfaces (display, controls, alarms). Software aspects integrate with IEC 62304; risk management integrates with ISO 14971; usability with IEC 62366-1.
